architecture-review.json.review: Existing Infrastructure factory gains an optional explicit comparison contract; parameterless filesystem detection unchanged. Existing Persistence store selects ordinal containment for its own generated paths. No project references, new runtime types, partial files, registries, safety cache, removed revalidation, durable protocol or locking changes. Existing analyzer diagnostics do not substitute direct builds. Actual selected-guard timing and durability/security regression validation pending.

final-resource-reconciliation.json.outcome: 75 cases passed (46 Unit,29 Integration). Identical selected SQL-wait performance reference passes after exact workspace path comparison removes repeated case probes: all six unrelated writers 162.67 to 670.72 ms while SQL holder remains. Measurement fixture cleanup confirmed. No sustained capacity claim; original failed reference retained. Historical cleanup denials remain unchanged.
